voice.summary: Reads like a good longform feature: patient, specific, a little wry. Cover lines promise a place and a mood, never a listicle.
dos: Open with a place or object, not a theme
Use numbers as nouns: four ferries, one bicycle
Write headlines in sentence case with a verb

taglines: Stories from the edge of the map
A magazine that takes its time
